timeline.finding: Thirteen admitted positions precede loss; the final one reports endpoint uncertainty.

Current registered same-source full POINT evidence contradicts accepted stable/adaptive material localization. FULL_HAND_INDEX_CONFLICT latches coordinateConflict, revokes index coordinate permission and model registration, and preserves only current hand identity. This is a genuine program-level coordinate contradiction, not a determination of which coordinate is physically correct.

Seventy-five fallback calls have conditionedReady=false. Fifty-seven qualified current geometry cohorts reach the old-finger reconfirmation appearance call, and every such appearanceSupportsIndex call returns false. No logical generation replacement occurs in RIGHT.

Incoming source identity equals the selected trusted source throughout. This is not the foreign-source quarantine transform that precedes the first SWEEP loss. Source-association reference expiry later occurs, but does not remove the delivered same-source full POINT evidence.

RIGHT.methodImplication: A proposal explicitly barred under genuine coordinateConflict cannot address the principal RIGHT loss by itself.

timeline.finding: Twelve image positions continue before appearance loss.
Appearance fails while a current full POINT cohort progresses through probation; a qualified associated model fallback supplies one position. Its optical registration candidate has only one frame.

BOTTOM_RIGHT.distinction: No coordinateConflict is observed in this stratum. Neural absence, failed old-image correspondence, and interrupted registration coexist; the RIGHT reconfirmation appearance call is not exercised here. Null model anchors are not equivalent to zero raw hands.

timeline.finding: The sequence enters from the preceding prompt already under unlatched foreign-source quarantine. Current full-quality old material retains only the already selected image identity clock; position remains paused.
Old-image appearance first fails after that paused interval; selected identity later expires.
Qualified current proof establishes a new outer logical identity and a short recovery; a reference-conflict frame interrupts otherwise admitted positions.
Registered index-cue disagreement latches a genuine coordinateConflict, a separate failure episode from the initial unlatched pause.
That selected identity expires; later raw reseeding, ambiguity, missing current geometry, and appearance failures do not establish further positions.

SWEEP.distinction: Seventeen POINT, eighteen unavailable-authority, and ten contrary-authority inputs are transformed to AMBIGUOUS by source association. Only fourteen of105 fallback calls have current valid geometry; three have a qualified full model cohort and two full-model readiness. This stratum contains multiple causal paths, not a single motion-window or freshness failure.
